purpose: Historical P04_19 bounded protocol. P03_15 and P06_02 remain development-only; use structured_prompt_ablation_v1.example.json for the next unrun plan.

fresh_public_source.historical_note: The official source was reviewed and used under the bounded local protocol. This file must not trigger a rerun, model change, or prompt tuning.

cpu_candidate_selection.decode_policy: exactly 16 fixed-rate decoded source frames spanning the short source; retain every decoded PTS/frame hash
cpu_candidate_selection.frame_source: frames_fixed only; dense scene frames are diagnostics and never substitute for the frozen pilot budget
cpu_candidate_selection.quality_exclusions: fixed-budget inputs are not quality-filtered; unreadable fixed input is a hard failure rather than a silent exclusion
cpu_candidate_selection.known_posthoc_limit: Pure change ranking did not guarantee source-span coverage; it is superseded for future tests by required uniform anchors plus leftover motion selection.
